name: ark-project
description: The Ark Project: one install point for the Ark's Claude Code plugins. Each entry points at the component's own repository at a pinned release; nothing is vendored here.

plugins.name: cars
plugins.description: Peer Session Ledger (the Ark manifest): register role and capabilities, find who to SendMessage. Ledger MCP server, roster, heartbeat, session-title and tmux hooks, /cars:register and /cars:deregister.

plugins.name: commlink
plugins.description: commlink (the Ark transport): register, discover and message peers across Claude, Codex and agy. MCP server plus Stop/SessionEnd lifecycle hooks.
